title: Progress
description: Schema for progress.json, the state of a package's tasks (format version 3). Written by the tools, never part of the contract.

updated_at.description: When a task last changed state, RFC 3339.

tasks.description: One entry per task of the plan and one for the integration task, in id order. A task with no entry is pending.

^x-.description: An extension key: a team's own metadata, any value, kept by every save. The format gives it no meaning.

covers.description: The id of a criterion the task owns, or for the integration task of an execution path.

no_red.description: The exemption: why the tests of this entry need not be seen failing first, the behaviour having existed before the task.

^x-.description: An extension key: a team's own metadata, any value, kept by every save. The format gives it no meaning.

test.description: The test identifier, as the evidence command takes it.

failed.description: The run in which speca saw the test fail; absent until then, and for an exempt test.

passed.description: The run in which speca saw the test pass when the task closed; absent until then.

^x-.description: An extension key: a team's own metadata, any value, kept by every save. The format gives it no meaning.

tree.description: The git tree id of the working tree the run was on, as the gate computes it; absent outside a git work tree.

^x-.description: An extension key: a team's own metadata, any value, kept by every save. The format gives it no meaning.

evidence.description: In a package that requires evidence, the tests that cover each criterion the task owns (for the integration task, each execution path), with the run in which speca saw each fail and the run in which it saw each pass. Written by speca <package> --task N --evidence and by the close; absent when the task has none.

^x-.description: An extension key: a team's own metadata, any value, kept by every save. The format gives it no meaning.
